BILL NUMBER:  S971

 TITLE OF BILL :

An act to amend the penal law, in relation to public distribution of
offensive sexual material


 SUMMARY :

This bill adds a new section 245.12 to the penal law. It states that
if a person is found guilty of public distribution of offensive sexual
material he/she will be found guilty of a Class A misdemeanor
punishable by a fine not to exceed $100 for each violation of this
section. Offensive sexual material is that material which depicts any
pictorial or other visual representation of a person or portion of the
human body which appeals to the prurient interest in sex.

 JUSTIFICATION :

In recent years, the introduction of "900" telephone numbers and
telephone sex lines has been increasing. Many companies have been
producing and distributing cards which contain these phone numbers
while illustrating obscene pictures. These cards are appearing as
litter in our streets, in front of our children's schools, and near
houses of worship.  This bill is a direct effort to decrease the
access of pornography to our vulnerable youth.

 FISCAL IMPLICATION :

None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect on the first of November next succeeding
the date on which it shall have become a law.

summary: Creates the crime of public distribution of offensive sexual material; makes the public distribution of offensive sexual material without charge a class A misdemeanor punishable by a fine not to exceed $100 for each violation.
title: Criminalizes public distribution of offensive sexual material
